skills.title: Air Advantage
skills.description: Can take off within 1 hex of an aircraft carrier. Ignores the effects of any terrain type on Mobility, ignores the effects of any land mines or naval mines, and enemy forces cannot counterattack when attacking. The combat effectiveness will not go down when HP is reduced

skills.title: Thrust Vectoring
skills.description: When attacked by land or naval forces, there is a 40% probability of dodging the damage. When attacked by air strike, there is a 10% probability of dodging the damage (excluding Missiles and Nuclear Bombs).

skills.title: Aerial Countermeasures
skills.description: Damage is increased by 10% against helicopters. After moving each turn, the next turn’s mobility is reduced by 12 (with minimum movement of 2 tiles) Full mobility are restored after resting for 1 turn within 1 tile of a friendly city, engineering unit or aircraft carrier.

skills.title: BVR Target Lock
skills.description: Increases damage dealt to armored units, artillery units, and naval units by 10%.

skills.title: Cluster Munition Missile
skills.description: During this turn, when your attack deals damage, it will also deal 20% damage to up to 3 units within a 1-tile radius of the target, prioritizing non-infantry units. This effect lasts for 1 turn. Cooldown of 3 turns.

skills.title: Relentless Offensive
skills.description: After making an attack, you can make one additional attack. This effect can trigger up to 1 times.

levels.note:
Unlock Air Advantage
Unlock Thrust Vectoring
Unlock Aerial Countermeasures
Unlock BVR Target Lock
Unlock Cluster Munition Missile 
Unlock Relentless Offensive
